ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

5. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.

6. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

7. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.

8. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.

9. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.

10. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

11. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.

12. When learning Combinational Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Combinational Logic Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Combinational Logic Circuits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project Implementation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
